items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: my brothers would get King Watsky and Buzz Harvey and the guys to come over and they'd play

ctx.x: Do you remember him practicing at home before he could play well? I don't think that's when he was just learning or anything?

Yes, I do remember that. He bought his first clarinet from a fellow by the name of Freddie Burns, who played with my brother Jimmy and played with King Watsky and Buzz Harvey, played bass. And they used to have a little band. They'd go out and play house parties. They all had day jobs, work days, and go out at night, you know, mostly on Saturday and Sunday, play all day picnics and all. And Freddie Burns sold Larry his first clarinet and gave Larry a few pointers on the clarinet. Well, Larry never did reading…
He learned himself then, mostly from then on.
